requiredRules: reuse and harden the canonical Golden Standard controls; never fork movement signs or camera-relative basis
mobile movement uses the canonical left touch joystick
mobile look uses the canonical goldenlook channel rendered as a visible right joystick
desktop DOM, layout and input behavior are a no-change regression lock
hide redundant keyboard/mouse hints and do not add joystick labels when controls are self-explanatory
keep the world as the dominant screen surface in portrait and landscape
portrait Dark Void eye visual scale is exactly 0.70 of its base size; landscape remains 1.00
compact Navigator; landscape is a thin bottom strip
move secondary actions into the existing Golden UI menu when available; otherwise use one fallback menu
provide a 44px+ fullscreen icon on every mobile playable game
retry Fullscreen API without navigationUI options if browser rejects the options object
never claim fullscreen success unless fullscreenElement or standalone display mode is actually active
use PWA standalone fallback where browser chrome cannot be removed programmatically
use viewport-fit=cover, dynamic visual viewport tracking and safe-area insets
when the software keyboard opens, keep Navigator above it and disable joysticks while typing
support any-pointer coarse and iPad desktop-UA touch detection without activating on normal desktop
async-rendered Navigator/buttons/hints are reconciled by one MutationObserver, not polling forever
regression tests cover installer idempotence, canonical runtime hardening, portrait, landscape, async DOM, fullscreen failure fallback, safe-area, menu and desktop-no-change
promotionRule: Promote to golden only after target integration, automated gates and real-device pass on iPhone + Android with desktop no-regression.
